audience.text: Python developers building desktop or server applications that require deterministic processing of Outlook MSG files and Compound File Binary containers without external dependencies or COM interop.

capabilities.text: Read and write Outlook MSG files using MapiMessage, including subject, body, recipients, attachments, and MAPI properties.
capabilities.title: Read and write MSG files

capabilities.text: Convert MSG to EML via to_email_message() and reconstruct MSG from EML via from_email_message() using Python's standard email package.
capabilities.title: Convert between MSG and EML

capabilities.text: Read, write, and traverse Compound File Binary containers using CFBReader, CFBWriter, CFBStorage, and CFBStream APIs.
capabilities.title: Low-level CFB processing

capabilities.text: Parse and inspect MSG property streams directly using MsgReader and MsgDocument for advanced scenarios.
capabilities.title: Low-level MSG property access

capabilities.text: Add regular and embedded-message attachments, and set recipients with display names and types via MapiMessage APIs.
capabilities.title: Add attachments and recipients

capabilities.text: Set and retrieve MAPI properties by property ID or named property using MapiMessage.set_property() and get_property_value().
capabilities.title: Set and get MAPI properties

limitations.text: No mail server connectivity: IMAP, SMTP, and POP3 are not supported.
TNEF (winmail.dat) parsing and generation is not implemented.
No dedicated calendar/appointment API; calendar MAPI properties must be accessed generically.
Direct .eml file parsing is not implemented; EML support requires Python's email.parser and EmailMessage.

problems_solved.text: Enables deterministic MSG and CFB file processing in pure Python without requiring Microsoft Outlook, COM interop, or compiled extensions.
Provides two-way conversion between MSG and EML formats using Python's standard email package, avoiding external mail server dependencies.
Supports low-level CFB and MSG structure inspection and construction via dedicated reader/writer APIs for advanced use cases.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, MIT-licensed library for reading, writing, and converting Outlook MSG and CFB files, with two-way conversion to/from Python's standard EmailMessage for EML handling.

workflows.name: Read MSG subject
workflows.text: Load an MSG file using MapiMessage.from_file() and access its subject property.

workflows.name: Create and save MSG
workflows.text: Create a new MapiMessage, set sender and recipient properties, add an attachment, and save it as MSG.

workflows.name: Convert MSG to EML
workflows.text: Load an MSG file, convert it to EmailMessage via to_email_message(), and write it to .eml using as_bytes().

workflows.name: Convert EML to MSG
workflows.text: Parse an .eml file using Python's BytesParser, then construct a MapiMessage from the EmailMessage and save it as MSG.

workflows.name: Inspect CFB structure
workflows.text: Build or read a CFB container using CFBReader/CFBWriter and traverse storages and streams.
